newsitem.title: GERMANY: German July motor vehicle output up 20 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: German July motor vehicle output up 20 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Germany's motor vehicle output rose 20 percent in July on a year-on-year basis, rising to 434,000 units, the VDA German vehicle association said on Friday.
The VDA also said vehicle output in the first seven months of 1997 was up five percent at 3.03 million units.
Total motor vehicle exports in July were up 15 percent from last year at 262,100 units and up eight percent in the first seven months of 1997 at 1.82 million units, the VDA said.
Exports of cars and estate cars were up 14 percent at 244,200 units in the month and up eight percent in the seven month period.
Commercial vehicle production rose 41 percent in July to 27,900 units and rose 14 percent to 198,600 unit in the first seven months of the year.
